name: incident_id
description: Incident id (= job_metadata.job_id for ingestion incidents).

name: subject
description: What the incident is about (file name); retries are counted per subject.

name: event_status
description: Status in the triggering event (FAILED / REJECTED).

name: status
description: AUTO_RESOLVED, AWAITING_HUMAN, APPROVED_BY_HUMAN, DUPLICATE or ERROR.

name: severity
description: SEV2 / SEV3 (raised one level on repeated failures).

name: category
description: Root-cause category: TRANSIENT_INFRA, DATA_QUALITY, CODE_BUG, CONFIG, UNKNOWN.

name: executed_actions
description: Actions executed in this record (by the agent or an approving human).

name: executed_retry_count
description: RETRY_FILE actions completed in this record.

name: report_path
description: Local path of the PDF report.
